chunks: 1577 - Harīz narrated from Zurārah and Muḥammad ibn Muslim that they both said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
What do you say about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,

“Indeed, charities are only for the poor, the needy, those employed over them, those whose hearts are to be reconciled, in freeing slaves, those in debt, in the way of Allah, and the stranded traveler, as an obligation from Allah.”

Should all of these be given, even if he does not recognize? He said: “Indeed, the Imam gives to all of these together because they acknowledge obedience to him.” Zurārah said: I said: What if they do not recognize? He said: “O Zurārah, if he were to give to the one who recognizes instead of the one who does not recognize, no place for it would be found. He only gives to the one who does not recognize so that he may be inclined toward the religion and become firm upon it. But as for today, then neither you nor your companions should give it except to one who recognizes. So whomever you find among these Muslims to be knowing, then give him instead of the people.”

Then he said: “The share of ‘those whose hearts are to be reconciled’ and the share of ‘the captives’ is general, while the remainder is specific.” He said: I said: What if they are not found? He said: “There cannot be an obligation that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has ordained without there being people eligible for it.”

He said: I said: What if the charities do not suffice them? He said: “Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has ordained for the poor in the wealth of the rich that which suffices them. Had He known that that would not suffice them, He would have increased it for them. They were not deprived on account of the obligation of Allah, Mighty and Majestic; rather, they were deprived because of the withholding of those who withheld their right from them, not because of what Allah ordained for them. If the people were to render their rights, they would be living well.”

key_terms.الرِّقَابِ: the category related to freeing captives or slaves
key_terms.الصَّدَقَاتُ: obligatory alms distributed to designated recipients
key_terms.الْفُقَرَاءِ: the poor who are entitled to financial support
key_terms.الْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ: those whose hearts are to be reconciled and inclined toward the religion
key_terms.حَقَّهُمْ: their due right owed to them from the wealth of others
key_terms.فَرِيضَةً: a binding obligation prescribed by Allah
key_terms.يَعْرِفُ: recognizes the Imam and his authority

ai.seo_question: Who is eligible to receive zakat according to Qur'an 9:60 in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the categories of zakat mentioned in the Qur'an and clarifies how the Imam عليه السلام administers them, including giving to some non-recognizers in order to incline them toward the religion. It also states that the divine ordinance of charity is sufficient for the poor in principle, and that deprivation results from people withholding the rights due to them, not from any deficiency in Allah’s legislation.
